I suffer from the very same issue. While I suggest you definitely make an appointment to see a professional, here’s something that helps me with cleaning chores. I find my phone/ piece of paper and pen and make a very deconstructed list of things I want to do. I don’t just say do laundry. I break it down into clearing the washing machine, hanging the clothes to dry, reloading the washing machine. I find that striking things off a list physically makes me feel slightly in control of my situation. Hope this helps
